doc.title: Functionality Not Available
doc.summary: This document outlines current features and functionalities that are not available or possible in the Hostel Management Configuration within the Digii campus-management platform.

chunks.what_it_does: Once a hostel policy is created in the Digii campus-management platform, it cannot be edited, archived, or deleted. Any required changes necessitate the creation of an entirely new policy.
chunks.why_it_matters: This limitation reduces flexibility for necessary adjustments, increasing administrative effort as administrators cannot easily update or remove existing policies.
how_to_use: To make changes to an existing hostel policy, create a new policy with the desired adjustments.
examples: An institution needs to update the terms of an existing hostel policy. Instead of editing the current one, they must create an entirely new policy to reflect the changes.

chunks.what_it_does: The Digii campus-management platform only allows one hostel policy to be active at any given time.
chunks.why_it_matters: This restriction prevents institutions from running multiple policies simultaneously, which would be helpful for different departments or special provisions for various student groups, limiting operational flexibility.
how_to_use: Ensure only one hostel policy is set as active at a time.
examples: A university wants to have one hostel policy for undergraduate students and another for postgraduate students. This is not possible as only one can be active in the system.

chunks.what_it_does: Once a hostel policy option is created and activated in the Digii campus-management platform, it cannot be modified. Any required changes to fees, dates, or other options necessitate creating a new policy.
chunks.why_it_matters: This inflexibility increases the administrative workload, as administrators must create entirely new policies for minor adjustments to policy options, such as fee changes or date modifications.
how_to_use: To change an activated hostel policy option, create a new hostel policy with the updated options.
examples: A hostel needs to adjust the fee for a specific room type within an active policy option. They cannot edit the existing option and must create a new policy to implement this change.

chunks.what_it_does: Although a Policy Option End Date can be set, the Digii campus-management platform does not automatically cancel room allotments after the policy ends. Hostel Administrators must manually cancel room allocations.
chunks.why_it_matters: This lack of automation increases the administrative effort for Hostel Administrators, as they need to perform manual cancellations for all expired room allotments, which can be time-consuming for large institutions.
how_to_use: Hostel Administrators must manually cancel room allotments after the Policy Option End Date has passed.
examples: A policy option for a semester ends on December 31st. The system will not automatically free up rooms; the Hostel Administrator must go into each student's record and manually cancel their room allotment.

chunks.feature_name: Room Capacity Modification Restriction After Allotment
chunks.what_it_does: Once rooms are allotted, their capacity cannot be changed in the Infrastructure Module of the Digii campus-management platform.
chunks.why_it_matters: This restriction limits flexibility in managing room allocation adjustments after the initial assignment, making it difficult to adapt to changing needs or reconfigure rooms, even if capacity changes are required.
how_to_use: Ensure room capacities are correctly set before any rooms are allotted, as they cannot be changed afterward.
examples: A hostel initially sets a room as a double, but after students are allotted, they realize it needs to be a single. The capacity cannot be changed without de-allotting the room first.

chunks.feature_name: No Bulk Upload for Hostel Policy Options
chunks.what_it_does: The Digii campus-management platform requires Hostel Policy Options to be added individually, as there is no bulk upload functionality available.
chunks.why_it_matters: This significantly increases the workload for the Hostel Administrator when a large number of options need to be configured, making the process inefficient and time-consuming.
how_to_use: Hostel Administrators must manually add each Hostel Policy Option one by one.
examples: A new academic year begins, and the hostel needs to configure 100 different policy options for various room types, durations, and fees. Each option must be entered individually.
